integrity.description: The agent calculates the AOP drift based on the 30-day propagation results rather than guessing.

integrity.description: The agent does not simply copy a pre-existing script from the desktop or home directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen manually configuring resources and commands within the GMAT interface.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Molniya orbit must have an inclination (INC_deg) near 63.4 degrees to minimize AOP drift. Expected SMA is ~26600 km (for a 12-hour period). Perigee altitude should be between 400-600 km (ECC ~0.74). The report must be located at /home/ga/GMAT_output/molniya_analysis.txt and the script at /home/ga/GMAT_output/molniya_mission.script. The force model must explicitly show Earth gravity harmonics of at least 4x4.
